description: Find orthologs and/or paralogs of a gene across species. Returns each homolog's stable ID, species, homology type (ortholog_one2one, ortholog_one2many, paralog_many2many, etc.), perc_id (percent identity), perc_pos (percent positives), and taxonomy level. Essential for cross-species research — for example, "what is the mouse equivalent of human TP53?" or "how conserved is BRCA2 across mammals?". Provide either symbol + species or a stable gene ID. Target species can be filtered to a single species or left open to return all available homologs.

id.description: Ensembl stable gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000139618). A version suffix (ENSG00000139618.17) is accepted and dropped before the query. Use ensembl_lookup_gene to get the stable ID from a symbol. Cannot be combined with symbol.

max_results.description: Maximum number of homologs to return. Broad orthology queries (e.g. BRCA2 across all species) can return 150+ homologs; the default keeps responses focused. Set to 0 to return every homolog uncapped. totalCount always reports the true number available before this cap.

species.description: Source species (the species the query gene belongs to) in Ensembl internal format. Default is homo_sapiens. Use ensembl_list_species with nameContains (a genus or common name, e.g. mouse) to find valid values.

symbol.description: Gene symbol in the source species (e.g. BRCA2, TP53). Species defaults to homo_sapiens; set species for other organisms. Cannot be combined with id.

target_species.description: Filter to homologs in a single target species (e.g. mus_musculus for mouse). Omit to return homologs across all available species. Use ensembl_list_species with nameContains (a genus or common name) to find valid values.

type.description: Type of homologs to return. orthologues: genes related by speciation (cross-species equivalents). paralogues: genes related by duplication (within or across species). all: both orthologs and paralogs.

name: ensembl_get_homology

cap.description: The max_results limit applied to the homolog list.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The gene symbol or stable ID was not found in Ensembl for the source species. `invalid_species`: The species or target_species string was not recognized by Ensembl. `no_input`: Neither symbol nor id was provided. `conflicting_input`: Both symbol and id were provided. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

homologs.description: Homologous genes found for the query gene, capped to max_results. totalCount reports the full count available before the cap.

items.description: A single homologous gene with its stable ID, species, homology type, and sequence identity metrics.

percId.description: Percent identity between the query and target gene sequences (0-100). Higher values indicate more conserved sequences.

percPos.description: Percent positive (similar) positions in the alignment (0-100). Includes conservative substitutions as well as identical residues.

targetId.description: Ensembl stable ID of the homologous gene in the target species.

targetSpecies.description: Target species in Ensembl internal format (e.g. mus_musculus).

taxonomyLevel.description: Last common ancestor taxonomic level for this homology relationship (e.g. Amniota, Vertebrata, Bilateria).

type.description: Homology type: ortholog_one2one, ortholog_one2many, ortholog_many2many, paralog_many2many, within_species_paralog, or similar.

notice.description: Guidance when no homologs are found or the list was capped.

queryId.description: The resolved Ensembl gene ID used for the homology query.

querySpecies.description: The source species used for the query.

queryType.description: The homology type queried (orthologues, paralogues, or all).

shown.description: Number of homologs returned after the max_results cap.

totalCount.description: Total number of homologs available before the max_results cap. Exceeds the returned homologs count when the list was capped.

truncated.description: True when the homolog list was capped at max_results.

title: Get Gene Homologs
